findings.what: Post-deadline stop order and night behaviour. Watchdog v2 (30176/16728) alerts when no clean poll.log header is seen for > 25 min. If R43-A8 stops the poller 37016 before the watchdog, it fires a false 'NO CLEAN POLL' ~25 min later (~00:32Z, 03:32 MSK), which can trigger a re-arm or a push while the user sleeps. Nothing after the user's 20:00Z tick decides anything. timer.sh re-checks the clock, so if the laptop sleeps after 23:00 MSK the 21:05Z and 00:07Z timers fire on wake.
findings.evidence: watchdog v2 command line (Win32_Process 16728); scratchpad timer.sh; round43/report.json R43-A8
findings.action: At 00:07Z stop the watchdog v2 (30176/16728) FIRST, then the poller 37016 and the rest of the R43-A8 list; verify with Get-Process. When sending the 21:05Z / 22:43 MSK messages, optionally tell the user once that after the 23:00 MSK tick the laptop may sleep: the finals are already ticked, and the commit runs whenever it wakes.
